theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pr_imrep_in_support
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid N)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents X ∧ R.carrier ⊆ X.support
